card.name: Eye-related terms and ophthalmic drug names
card.fires_on: Words in eye-medicine text where the next word is likely eye-related, such as the end of a drug name just before 'ophthalmic', or partway through 'conjunctival' or 'retrobulbar'. Also the word 'eyes' and eyewear terms.

modes.label: Drug name before ophthalmic
